overview: Embark on a luxurious 5-day journey through Egypt, exploring its rich cultural and religious heritage. This itinerary is designed for a couple seeking a slow-paced experience, filled with historical sites, beautiful gardens, and memorable dining.

stops.name: Monastery of Abu Mina
stops.description: UNESCO-listed pilgrimage site with ancient ruins and a modern monastery.
stops.address: 9 Mar-Mina Rd, Qetaa Maryout, Borg El Arab, Alexandria Governorate 21934, Egypt
stops.tip: Free entry — great for a budget stop

stops.name: Royal Jewelry Museum
stops.description: Houses the exquisite jewels of the Muhammad Ali dynasty.
stops.address: 27 Ahmed Yehia, San Stefano, El Raml 2, Alexandria Governorate 5451010, Egypt

stops.name: Antoniadis Gardens
stops.description: Vast botanical gardens containing Greco-Roman style statues.
stops.address: ش البرت الأول، Smoha Sq., Sidi Gabir, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5432034, Egypt

stops.name: Shallalat Gardens
stops.description: Features waterfalls and remains of the city’s Islamic walls.
stops.address: 6W37+3RF, Bab Sharqi WA Wabour Al Meyah, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5423005, Egypt
stops.tip: Free entry — great for a budget stop

stops.name: San Stefano Mall
stops.description: Upscale shopping and dining in the city's tallest building.
stops.address: El-Gaish Rd, San Stefano, El Raml 2, Alexandria Governorate 5452053, Egypt
stops.tip: Free entry — great for a budget stop

stops.name: Smouha Club
stops.description: Massive social and sporting club in the heart of the city.
stops.address: Victor Emanouil Al Thaleth, Ezbet Saad, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5432080, Egypt

stops.name: Gleem Bay
stops.description: A modern hub for restaurants built directly over the sea.
stops.address: Glime Beach, San Stefano, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 5452033, Egypt

tips: Consider hiring a private guide for a more personalized experience at each site.
Take your time to enjoy local cuisine at each destination, especially in Aswan.
Dress modestly when visiting religious sites to show respect.
Stay hydrated and take breaks to fully enjoy the beautiful gardens and parks.
Be flexible with your schedule to allow for spontaneous discoveries.
summary: Enjoy your enchanting journey through Egypt, filled with culture, history, and romance.
